3. Save to Utility Network

Upload Excel and check the editable values before saving. Reference-only columns are not submitted.

Excel blank cells leave values unchanged. Use __NULL__ to clear a nullable field, or __EMPTY__ for empty text. Apply and submit writes the supplied changes directly to the matching Global IDs after validation. Check your values before clicking.

SURVEY DATA QUALITY

Survey Quality Monitor

Select the surveyor usernames and the device or junction layers you want to monitor.

1. Electric Device · Structure Junction · Electric Line

Sign in and open a Feature Service in Attribute Manager, then load its layers here. Select Electric Device, Structure Junction and Electric Line to check all three in the same run. Each space has its own required-field choices. Only accessible records are covered.

Selects available layers linked to the three spaces. Choose required attributes in each space.

These are service tracking usernames, which may belong to a sync account rather than the surveyor. No usernames or field names are guessed.

Save your chosen attribute rules for Electric Device, Structure Junction and Electric Line here. This saves monitoring settings only.

Your checking template is still pending. Until then, explicitly check the fields to treat as required. Optional fields will not trigger alerts.

Monitoring boundary / district

Use your supplied 2022 administrative boundaries to choose where to monitor Electric Device, Structure Junction and Electric Line.

Sectors to monitor

Choose a province to monitor it all, or narrow to a district and tick one or more sectors. Source: Boundaries_2022.gdb (2022).

Other boundary service (optional)

Use a boundary layer from your approved service origin. For a different origin, open that service in Attribute Manager first to approve the connection, then return to your network service.

Checks include features intersecting the selected polygon, including lines that cross it. The username list remains service-wide.

2. Choose surveyors from created_user

These are usernames present in readable UN records, not a list of people currently signed in.

Select each layer’s username field, such as created_user, above. This loads its distinct values like ArcGIS Pro’s Values list, across every accessible page. No record in the selected layers means no username value to list.

Load layers, select a layer and its username field, then load username values.

Load username values, then select the usernames to watch.

This checks every accessible record in the selected layers on each scan, including newly added records. Leave unchecked to monitor only the usernames you tick.

Select usernames and layers, then save your monitoring link. No passwords or session tokens are saved.

3. Monitor all selected spaces and receive notifications

Monitoring is stopped. Choose layers, required fields and usernames first.

Alerts flag NULL, empty text and whitespace. Zero and false are valid values. Checks run only while this app stays open and signed in; background tabs may delay checks. No email or closed-app delivery is configured.

Each feature alert shows username, missing attributes and Global ID. Click a result row for details and Open in ArcGIS Pro. The browser may ask permission to open the desktop app.

Coverage and problems

Continue your query

Restore your attribute filter, Global ID search, selected layers, required fields and surveyor usernames. Passwords, uploads, unsaved edits and live monitoring are not restored.

These are the attributes selected for monitoring, recorded at the last check. NULL and blank text are listed separately. Zero, false and domain values such as Unknown count as filled.
